releases.notes:
A Fabric port of the ‘Your Reputation’ mod for Minecraft 26.3 (based on the 26.1.2 source code).

## Features
- Jade plugin: Displays your reputation with villagers (Friendly / Trustworthy / Neutral / Suspicious / Hostile) in the villager tooltip
- When your affinity is ‘Hostile’, villagers will become snitches, and iron golem will attack you furiously
- Supports Minecraft 26.3 + Fabric + Jade

## Dependencies
- Minecraft 26.3
- Fabric Loader >= 0.19.5
- Fabric API (0.161.0+26.3 recommended)
- Jade (26.3.3+fabric or later)

> Note: There is a known issue with Jade 26.3.4+fabric causing a `StackOverflowError` when loading configurations (unrelated to this mod); it is recommended to use 26.3.3+fabric.

## Your Reputation 0.1.0 for Minecraft 26.1.2

Port of Your Reputation mod to Minecraft 26.1.2 Fabric (Mojmap) with Jade support.

> **Disclaimer:** Since the original author has not updated this mod for Minecraft 26.1.2, I ported this version myself. If this infringes any rights, please contact me and I will remove this repository.

### Changes
- Updated to Minecraft 26.1.2 with Mojmap mappings
- Updated Java to 25, Loom to 1.16-SNAPSHOT, Gradle to 9.5.1
- Fixed Villager class path to net.minecraft.world.entity.npc.villager.Villager
- Fixed DefendVillageTargetGoal field names (potentialTarget, attackTargeting)
- Replaced EntityType.getName() with getDescription()
- Updated Jade API integration for 26.1
